title: How-to, operations, reference pages, architecture fix and CI docs job
goal: docs/how-to/*, docs/operations/*, docs/reference/*.md (кроме api/), правка docs/architecture/invariants.md про retry, job docs в .github/workflows/ci.yml

checks.cmd: ! grep -n "retried at most" docs/architecture/invariants.md && ls docs/how-to/*.md docs/operations/*.md docs/reference/*.md >/dev/null

instructions: reference/error-codes — собрать коды из исключений пакетов (grep по packages/*/src/**/Exceptions); reference/events — типы outbox/доменных событий из кода; extension-kinds — из docs/architecture/extension.md; artisan-commands — список из assembly-design#baseline с описаниями из классов команд. CI job docs: setup-node 22, npm ci/build в docs, composer docs:reference -- --check.

outcome.notes: unit work reviewed by the integrator; item checks V1-V5 green
